questions.prompt: (Exam 2023, reading, question 2) A text says: "After lunchtime, the competition starts." When does the competition start?

options.text: in the morning
in the evening
at lunchtime, during the meal
in the afternoon

questions.explanation: After lunchtime means later than the midday meal, and the part of the day that follows lunchtime is the afternoon. The competition does not start during the meal, it starts after it, and it cannot be in the morning, which comes before lunch, or in the evening, which comes much later.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023, reading, question 1a) A text says about Zoey: "She enjoys flying kites and playing volleyball in the playground. But her favourite hobby is drawing. She always draws pictures of her friends jumping and swinging."

The exam asks: True or False? "Zoey plays on the swing with her friends." Which answer is right?

options.text: False: she draws her friends on the swing, she does not play there
True: she always draws her friends jumping and swinging with her at school
True: children play on the swing in every school playground
False: she never plays in the playground, she only draws

questions.explanation: The text says that Zoey draws pictures of her friends swinging: she is the artist, not one of the children on the swing, so the statement is False. A True answer built on the drawings reads the words but not the sentence, and a True answer built on what usually happens in a playground is not an answer from the text. The idea that she never plays in the playground is false: the text says that she plays volleyball there.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023, reading, question 1b) A text says about a school drawing competition: "Students are very excited. They draw many pictures."

The exam asks: True or False? "Students enjoy the drawing competition." Which answer is right?

options.text: False: the students only draw because their teachers ask them
True: the students are very excited and they draw many pictures
True: the students win a gift at the end of the day
False: the text does not say anything about the students' feelings

questions.explanation: Very excited tells how the students feel, and drawing many pictures shows that they take part with pleasure, so the statement is True. The idea that they only obey their teachers is not in the text, the gift is for one winner, not for the students, and the text does speak about their feelings.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023, reading, question 3) In paragraph three, the headmistress says: "let's welcome the best artist of our school, Zoey!" and Zoey "takes her gift and smiles". Which two words from paragraph three complete the summary?

"Zoey draws the ___ picture in the school. She wins a lovely ___ ."

options.text: best ... gift
best ... prize
first ... gift
favourite ... gift

questions.explanation: The two words must come from paragraph three: the headmistress names Zoey the best artist of the school, and Zoey takes her gift. The word prize is the word a competition usually brings to mind, but the text says gift, and first is not in the paragraph either. The word favourite belongs to the first paragraph, where it describes her hobby.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2023, reading, question 4) A text says about the end of the day: "In her wheelchair, Zoey comes." Complete the sentence of the exam: Zoey can't jump because...

options.text: she is tired after the competition
she is afraid of heights
she is in a wheelchair
she prefers drawing to jumping

questions.explanation: The text tells that Zoey comes in her wheelchair, and a person who moves in a wheelchair cannot jump: this is the reason the text gives. Being tired, being afraid of heights or preferring drawing are reasons that nobody writes in the text, they only seem likely.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2023, reading) A text has three paragraphs: the first presents Zoey and her hobbies, the second tells about a school drawing competition, and the third tells about the party at the end of the day. Which title fits the whole text?

options.text: Zoey flies kites and plays volleyball in the playground
Zoey wins the school drawing competition
Zoey's friends jump and swing
The teachers' party

questions.explanation: A title must cover the three paragraphs: Zoey and her favourite hobby, the competition, and the moment when she is named the best artist. Flying kites, the friends who jump and the party are true details, but each one covers only a small part of the text.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2023, reading) At the end of the text, the headmistress says: "let's welcome the best artist of our school, Zoey!" Then Zoey's teachers and friends hug her and tell her: "we are proud of you, Zoey!" Why are they proud of her?

options.text: because it is her birthday and the school is having a party
because she is the best artist of the school
because she plays volleyball very well
because she helps the art teachers get ready for the event

questions.explanation: They tell her that they are proud of her, and the headmistress has just named her the best artist of the school: this is the reason of the hug. A birthday, playing volleyball very well or helping the teachers are not the reason the text gives: the headmistress has just named her the best artist of the school.
